title: Invoices: a discount that adds, and a missing --json
about: A small package across five modules: a discount applied with the wrong sign, and a CLI flag the tests expect that does not exist yet.
task: The test suite in this repository fails. Make every test pass by changing the code under invoices/ -- do not edit anything under tests/. Run `python -m pytest -q` to confirm, and stop when it is green.
